        rows.append((p[5].strip().lower(),int(p[1])))
tot=sum(r[1] for r in rows)
print(len(rows),tot)
for n,c in sorted(rows,key=lambda x:-x[1])[:40]: print(n,c,round(100*c/tot,4))
